天津市张工市长在《政府工作报告》中提出 2026 年要重点抓好 8 项工作，在“（三）着力构建现代化产业体系”中特别提到：“航空航天产业强化龙头引领，在大飞机、大火箭、卫星制造及应用、宇航电池、航空材料等领域系统性提升配套基础......推动电科蓝天、云遥宇航等扩大产能。”

作为天津商业航天领域的代表性企业，云遥宇航正紧抓“十五五”开局机遇，将全力推进产能扩张与技术迭代。此次被纳入《政府工作报告》重点支持企业之一，将进一步推动公司在卫星批产、数据应用等领域的突破，力争为天津构建“空天一体化”产业体系、打造商业航天高地注入新动能。

# 《政府工作报告》（摘要）

**2026年重点工作**

市长张工在报告中说，今年是“十五五”开局起步之年。政府工作总体要求是：以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，认真贯彻中央经济工作会议精神，全面落实习近平总书记视察天津重要讲话精神和对天津工作一系列重要指示要求，按照市委工作部署，聚焦经济建设这一中心工作和高质量发展这一首要任务，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，积极服务和融入构建新发展格局，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，更好统筹发展和安全，以推进京津冀协同发展为战略牵引，扎实实施高质量发展“十项行动”，深入推进科技创新、产业焕新、城市更新，深化盘活存量、做优增量、提升质量，因地制宜发展新质生产力，充分激发有效需求，持续防范化解重点领域风险，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，推动经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长，不断提高人民生活水平，保持社会和谐稳定，实现“十五五”良好开局。

今年经济社会发展主要预期目标是：地区生产总值增长4.5%，在实际工作中努力争取更好结果；一般公共预算收入增长2%；固定资产投资提质增效；城镇调查失业率5.5%左右，城镇新增就业28万人；居民消费价格涨幅2%左右；居民收入增长和经济增长基本同步；节能减排减污降碳指标完成国家下达目标。

在实际工作中，我们要更加注重稳中求进、提质增效，不断充实、巩固、拓展高质量发展动能和质效；更加注重因地制宜、深挖潜能、紧密结合天津实际，用足用好中央存量政策与增量政策集成赋能，在服务京津冀协同发展深化进程中，在扬长补短、进取推进自身经济转型发展进程中，做实做优存量增量双支撑；更加注重积极进取、攻坚克难，激发改革创新动力，更好发挥有效市场和有为政府作用，项目化清单化推动“十项行动”和“三新”、“三量”工作聚势增效；更加注重盯紧盯实、抓牢抓严中央巡视等指出问题整改落实，切实把整改效果体现为经济发展、民生改善、城市治理、环境提升、风险化解的务实成效。

# 重点抓好以下工作：

**01、持续发挥京津冀协同发展效能**

对接融入首都产业协同圈。聚焦首都创新资源、总部资源、产业资源、服务资源、平台资源，紧密对接北京重点产业、高校院所、中关村等园区，重点深化首都科技成果在津转化产业化、产业资源在津拓链展业。聚焦首都产业配套服务需求，主动引导自身产业适配接轨、链条互补，对接央企疏解资源关联企业意向，支持域内企业市场化融入产业链群，在服务得上、服务得好、服务得有竞争力上下功夫。聚焦首都产业优势，同央企京企联手市场化引育外部资源就近配套、供需对接，夯实天津服务首都产业支撑基础。

 主动融入首都通勤圈。重点发挥站产城综合枢纽节点时空优势，加快轨道协同向产业协同升维升级。聚焦“京业津住”、“津产京才”、“京业展业”，深化“高铁+”、“园区+”、“职住+”、“服务+”协同，优化提升西站同城商务区、南站科技商务区、滨海站“于响”商务区、武清站商务区等产业合作承载功能，重点做好入职、入住、落户、入学服务和商务政务服务，在深度融入和积极引入中着力提高服务于产业、服务于人的吸引力。谋划轨道交通向“通武廊”延伸。

积极融入首都功能圈。创新园区共建共赢机制，深化主导产业合作，推动天津滨海—中关村科技园、宝坻京津中关村科技城、武清京津产业新城等既有平台特色化差异化发展，协同做好宁河京津合作示范区资源导入和公共服务。深化社会事业、政务服务、文化旅游、生态环境保护协同，拓展跨省（市）通办范围。更好支持雄安新区高标准高质量建设。

**02、全面强化科技创新支撑引领**

积极共建北京（京津冀）国际科技创新中心。聚焦天津所长、所需、所能，机制化畅通与驻津央院央所、高校研发平台等“握手”通道，推进科研设备共享、设施共用、团队梯次共建，支持“六链五群”重点企业与战略科技力量加强产学研合作，注重扬长避短，争建国家脑机接口技术创新中心、国家血液病医学中心，在信创、人工智能、合成生物、中医药等特色领域体现天津价值支撑，积极引导高校院所、全国重点实验室、科技领军企业，在智算芯片、超算智算互联、脑机接口、细胞与基因治疗等关键技术突破上作出天津创新贡献。

增强天开园全域全要素创新引领辐射。进一步完善“一核两翼多点”建设体系，全面激发创新策源、创新链接、创新服务、创新生态活力，升级提效支持政策，加速释放示范带动和品牌溢出效应。注重特色赛道培育，坚持自身成果转化和外部引育并重，建立跨区域跨产业应用场景等服务机制，精准滴灌选种子、育苗子、培尖子、结果子，培育新一代信息技术、生物医药、新能源新材料等主导产业，持续建设科技创新和产业创新融合发展高地。

做优科创服务生态。大力发展研究开发、概念验证、知识产权、企业孵化等业态，建设20个校企联合实验室，加快重点产业和领域中试平台建设，全市技术合同成交额突破2300亿元。积极发展科技金融，壮大“种子+天使+创投+产业+并购”基金群，用好科创债资源，发挥OTC市场科技金融路演中心作用和“专精特新”专板集聚功能，促进更多科技型企业上市。强化企业创新决策主体、组织主体地位和科技成果转化核心载体作用，支持承担重大科技攻关任务、牵头组织实施科技专项、建设高水平创新平台，培育更多科技领军企业、国家级制造业单项冠军、专精特新“小巨人”。

一体推进教育科技人才发展。推动新一轮高校“双一流”建设，深入实施高等教育学科专业设置调整优化三年行动，加快市域产教联合体和行业产教融合共同体实体化运行。推广科技成果“先使用后付费”等新机制。强化人才服务保障，实施科技领军人才引进和青年科技人才培养项目，深化产业工人队伍建设改革。

**03、着力构建现代化产业体系**

推动制造业转型升级、提质增效。以数智赋能、技改绿改、市场化合作为抓手，增强存量增量项目后劲支撑，促进传统产业加快升级、新兴和未来产业培育壮大。绿色石化产业以南港工业区为重要承载地，做实绿色石化科创中心，实施中石化催化剂、中海油新材料、燕山石化绿色新材料、金科日化精细化工等重点项目，加快打造绿色化工新材料基地。汽车产业重点抓好整车制造、关键部件配套、智能网联配套服务三条主线，加快“三台车”新车型导入，充分发挥中汽中心、中汽工程等重点行业优势资源赋能。装备制造产业围绕海工装备、新能源装备、电工装备、工业母机聚势聚链、扩能升级，服务好中海油装备智能制造投产，加快中船、中远海运等船舶制修造项目建设，推动三一重能风电整机、特变电工智慧产业园、通用机床研究院等投运增效。**航空航天产业强化龙头引领，在大飞机、大火箭、卫星制造及应用、宇航电池、航空材料等领域系统性提升配套基础，拓展与空客、航天科技、中航工业等供应链合作，推动电科蓝天、云遥宇航等扩大产能**。信息技术产业依托曙光、海光、麒麟、飞腾、联想、中芯国际、华海清科、天河超算、金海通等头部企业，在服务器、自主芯片、智能终端、集成电路制造及装备上强链补链，在“AI+信创”上打造更多应用场景，联动提升操作系统、工业软件、智算服务、信息安全等适配基础。生物医药和医疗器械产业用好全国重点实验室、高校院所等创新资源，强化药械研发—生产制造—临床应用全链条服务，促进诺和诺德、碧迪等重点外企，华润、招商局、国投等央企业务板块，合源生物、瑞普生物等民企深化布局。循环经济产业推动再生资源回收利用、设备维修再制造等集聚发展，支持中资环在津打造全国性、功能性的资源回收再利用平台。

 加快生产性服务业转型发展。用好自身市场资源、产业场景应用资源和服务业开放优势，注重与头部企业合作，因地制宜发展平台经济、金融服务、航运物流、工程设计、算力应用、商务会展、批零仓储等，推动生产性服务业为制造业赋能。深入实施“人工智能+”行动，加快国家数字经济创新发展试验区建设，支持平台企业创新和健康发展。

 强化存量增量双支撑。深度挖掘楼宇、园区、厂房、产能、品牌等存量资源，市场化导入先进制造、研发孵化、商务金融、文化创意等新业态，促进产业空间供给与优质要素需求更新匹配。持续做大增量支撑，向存量产业提质增效要增量，向科技成果转化要增量，向高端产业链群配套要增量，向引育新动能资源要增量，以优质增量提高发展质量。

**04、进一步挖掘有效需求潜力**

扩容提质多元消费。大力推进国际消费中心城市建设，深入实施提振消费专项行动，优化消费品以旧换新政策实施，统筹促进线上消费与线下消费、本地消费与外来消费、商品消费与服务消费、多样性消费与改善性消费。线上消费重点引育以信息技术为支撑的专业化特色化平台服务企业，更好释放即时零售、悦己服务等新需求；服务消费强化投资于人、服务于人导向，丰富养老、托幼、健康、家政等连锁化规模化服务供给，更好满足家居类、信息文化服务类等多样性改善需求；外来消费着力提升观光、演艺、赛事、旅居、研学等特色消费体验，完善入境消费便利化体系。聚焦准入、场景、业态、供需，加快清理不合理限制措施，营造良好消费环境。

稳步扩大有效益投资。坚持项目建设确有所需、确能支撑、确实可行，用好“两重”、“两新”、新型政策性金融工具等，强化市、区两级重大项目提级调度机制，加快标志性产业项目和百亿级项目建设，拓展技术改造、环境保护治理、城市更新、市政交通等投资增量。聚焦产业投资，加快已签约在施重大项目进度，推动“117项目”核心区、新和成南港新材料、飞毛腿绿色储能、恒瑞创新药、玉湖冷链交易中心等建设。优化基础设施投资，推动机场三期、京滨城际南段、津潍高铁等工程，加快京津塘、津沧、兴港等高速公路建设，建成地铁8号线一期及延伸线，加快推进7号线一期北段、11号线延伸线、东北角“一站两区间”、B1、Z2等地铁建设，推进龙潭沟抽水蓄能电站等项目。稳定房地产投资，用好“白名单”制度和增量政策，有序推动“好房子”建设，着力建设华苑—南站、新梅江、水西、柳林、西站等特色宜居片区。激发民间投资，支持民间资本有序参与基础设施、公共服务项目建设，持续丰富REITs项目储备库并加快项目转化落地。做好用地用能、安评环评等服务保障，深化“市场+资源+应用场景”招商，做优招商增量质效。

**05、加快释放改革开放成效**

# "Summary of the Government Work Report"

**Key tasks for 2026**

Mayor Zhang Gong stated in his report that this year marks the beginning of the 14th Five-Year Plan period. The overall requirements for government work are as follows: guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, we must thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and all previous plenary sessions of the 20th Central Committee, conscientiously follow the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, fully carry out the important speech given by General Secretary Xi Jinping during his inspection of Tianjin and a series of important instructions and requirements for Tianjin's work, and in accordance with the work deployment of the municipal Party committee, focus on economic construction as the central task and high-quality development as the primary task. We must fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development concept, actively serve and integrate into the construction of a new development pattern, adhere to the general work principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, better coordinate development and safety, take the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei as a strategic driving force, solidly implement the "Ten Actions" for high-quality development, further promote technological innovation, industrial renewal, and urban renewal, deepen the revitalization of existing resources, optimize incremental resources, improve quality, develop new productive forces according to local conditions, fully stimulate effective demand, continuously prevent and resolve risks in key areas, focus on stabilizing employment, enterprises, markets, and expectations, promote effective improvement in quality and reasonable growth in quantity of the economy, continuously improve people's living standards, maintain social harmony and stability, and achieve a good start for the 14th Five-Year Plan.

The main expected goals for economic and social development this year are as follows: the regional GDP is expected to grow by 4.5%, and efforts will be made to achieve better results in practical work; general public budget revenue is expected to increase by 2%; fixed assets investment is expected to improve in quality and efficiency; the surveyed urban unemployment rate is expected to be around 5.5%, with an additional 280,000 urban jobs created; the consumer price index is expected to rise by around 2%; the growth of residents' income is expected to basically synchronize with economic growth; and the targets for energy conservation, emission reduction, pollution reduction, and carbon reduction set by the state are expected to be achieved.

In practical work, we must place greater emphasis on seeking progress while maintaining stability, improving quality and efficiency, and continuously enriching, consolidating, and expanding the momentum and quality-effectiveness for high-quality development. We should pay more attention to adapting to local conditions, tapping into potential, and closely integrating with the reality of Tianjin. We should fully utilize the integrated empowerment of existing and new policies from the central government, and in the process of serving the deepening of coordinated development in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and in the process of promoting our own economic transformation and development by leveraging our strengths and addressing our weaknesses, we should solidify and optimize the dual support of existing and new policies. We should pay more attention to actively striving for progress, tackling difficulties, stimulating the momentum for reform and innovation, and better leveraging the roles of an effective market and a proactive government. We should promote the "Ten Actions" and the "Three New" and "Three Quantities" work through project-based and checklist-oriented approaches to gather momentum and enhance efficiency. We should pay more attention to closely monitoring and rigorously implementing the rectification of issues identified by central inspections, and effectively translate the rectification results into tangible achievements in economic development, improvement of people's livelihood, urban governance, environmental enhancement, and risk resolution.


# Focus on the following tasks:

**01. Continuously leverage the efficiency of coordinated development in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region**

Integrate into the capital's industrial collaboration circle. Focus on the capital's innovation resources, headquarters resources, industrial resources, service resources, and platform resources, closely connect with Beijing's key industries, universities and research institutions, Zhongguancun and other parks, and focus on deepening the transformation and industrialization of capital's scientific and technological achievements in Tianjin, as well as expanding and developing industrial resources in Tianjin. Focus on the capital's industrial supporting service needs, actively guide the adaptation and integration of one's own industry, complement the industrial chain, connect with central enterprises' intention to relocate resource-related enterprises, support the market-oriented integration of enterprises in the region into industrial chains and clusters, and work hard to provide services that are accessible, good, and competitive. Focus on the capital's industrial advantages, work with central enterprises and Beijing enterprises to market-orientedly attract and cultivate external resources for nearby supporting, supply and demand docking, and consolidate the foundation of Tianjin's service support for the capital's industries.

Actively integrate into the commuter circle of the capital. Emphasize the spatiotemporal advantages of the integrated hub nodes of stations, industries, and cities, and accelerate the upgrading and upgrading of rail coordination to industrial coordination. Focus on "Beijing industry, Tianjin residence", "Tianjin industry, Beijing talent", and "Beijing industry, exhibition industry", deepen the coordination of "high-speed rail +", "park +", "residential area +", and "service +", optimize and enhance the industrial cooperation and carrying capacity of the West Railway Station Business District, South Railway Station Technology Business District, Binhai Station "Yuxiang" Business District, and Wuqing Station Business District, focus on providing services for employment, housing, settling, and education, as well as business and government services, and strive to improve the attractiveness of serving industries and people in the process of deep integration and active introduction. Plan to extend rail transit to "Tongzhou-Wuqing-Langfang".

Actively integrate into the functional circle of the capital. Innovate the mechanism for joint construction and win-win cooperation in parks, deepen cooperation in leading industries, promote the characteristic and differentiated development of existing platforms such as Tianjin Binhai-Zhongguancun Science and Technology Park, Baodi Beijing-Tianjin Zhongguancun Science and Technology City, and Wuqing Beijing-Tianjin Industrial New City, and collaborate to introduce resources and provide public services in the Ninghe Beijing-Tianjin Cooperation Demonstration Zone. Deepen coordination in social undertakings, government services, cultural tourism, and ecological environment protection, and expand the scope of cross-provincial (city) services. Better support the high-standard and high-quality construction of the Xiong'an New Area.

**02. Comprehensively strengthen the support and leadership role of scientific and technological innovation**

Actively collaborate to build the Beijing (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei) International Science and Technology Innovation Center. Focusing on Tianjin's strengths, needs, and capabilities, institutionalize and smoothen the "handshaking" channels with central institutions and research platforms in Tianjin, universities, and other entities. Promote the sharing of scientific research equipment, facilities, and collaborative team building. Support key enterprises and strategic technological forces in the "six chains and five clusters" to strengthen industry-university-research cooperation. Emphasize on leveraging strengths and avoiding weaknesses. Strive to establish a national brain-computer interface technology innovation center and a national hematology medical center. Demonstrate Tianjin's value support in characteristic fields such as information and communication technology, artificial intelligence, synthetic biology, and traditional Chinese medicine. Actively guide universities, research institutions, national key laboratories, and leading technology enterprises to make Tianjin's innovative contributions to key technological breakthroughs in areas such as smart computing chips, supercomputing and intelligent computing interconnection, brain-computer interfaces, and cell and gene therapy.

Enhance the innovation leadership and radiation across the entire region and all elements of Tiankai Park. Further improve the "one core, two wings, multiple points" construction system, fully stimulate the vitality of innovation sourcing, innovation linking, innovation services, and innovation ecology, upgrade and enhance supporting policies, and accelerate the release of demonstration drive and brand spillover effects. Focus on cultivating characteristic tracks, adhere to the equal emphasis on self-transformation of achievements and external introduction and cultivation, establish service mechanisms such as cross-regional and cross-industry application scenarios, precisely and precisely select seeds, nurture seedlings, cultivate top talents, and bear fruits, cultivate leading industries such as new-generation information technology, biomedicine, new energy, and new materials, and continue to build a highland for the integrated development of scientific and technological innovation and industrial innovation.

Optimize the science and technology innovation service ecosystem. Vigorously develop research and development, concept verification, intellectual property rights, enterprise incubation, and other business formats, establish 20 joint laboratories between schools and enterprises, accelerate the construction of pilot platforms in key industries and fields, and achieve a technology contract turnover exceeding 230 billion yuan in the city. Actively develop technology finance, expand the "seed + angel + venture capital + industry + mergers and acquisitions" fund group, make good use of science and technology innovation bond resources, leverage the role of the OTC market technology finance roadshow center and the aggregation function of the "specialized, refined, unique, and innovative" special board, and promote more technology enterprises to go public. Strengthen the role of enterprises as the main body in innovation decision-making and organization, as well as the core carrier for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Support undertaking major scientific and technological breakthrough tasks, leading the organization and implementation of science and technology special projects, building high-level innovation platforms, and cultivating more technology leading enterprises, national manufacturing champions in individual fields, and "little giants" that are specialized, refined, unique, and innovative.

Promote the integrated development of education, science, technology, and talent. Advance the new round of "Double First-Class" construction in universities, thoroughly implement the three-year action plan for adjusting and optimizing the discipline and major settings in higher education, and accelerate the operationalization of city-level industry-education consortia and industry-education integration communities. Promote the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, and enhance its quality and efficiency. Leverage our own market resources, industry scenario application resources, and advantages in service industry openness. Emphasize cooperation with leading enterprises, and develop the platform economy, financial services, shipping logistics, engineering design, computing power applications, business exhibitions, wholesale and retail warehousing, etc., tailored to local conditions, to promote productive service industries to empower the manufacturing industry. Deeply implement the "Artificial Intelligence+" initiative, accelerate the construction of national digital economy innovation and development pilot zones, and support the innovation and healthy development of platform enterprises.

Strengthen dual support from both existing and incremental resources. Deeply tap into existing resources such as buildings, parks, factories, production capacity, and brands, and introduce new business forms such as advanced manufacturing, R&D incubation, business finance, and cultural creativity into the market, promoting the renewal and matching of industrial space supply with high-quality factor demand. Continue to expand incremental support, seeking growth from improving the quality and efficiency of existing industries, transforming scientific and technological achievements, supporting high-end industrial chains and clusters, and attracting and cultivating new driving resources, in order to enhance development quality through high-quality growth.

Support other districts in characteristic development and making efforts in multiple areas, promoting key development zones to become active, operational, and supportive, mobilizing the potential of each park, and using development achievements to support and serve the overall situation.

We will intensify efforts in ecological and environmental protection and governance.
